omissionReason: All six image references belong to the old marketing homepage, not the preserved app-route views; they remain only in the private eight-file recovery snapshot.
routingChange: The baseline wildcard /* /index.html 200 is replaced by four exact app-route rewrites to the canonical /__app/ asset path. Trailing slashes normalize with 301 redirects. Direct shell aliases redirect to /dashboard. Unsupported job-child paths and unknown marketing paths return 404; /api is never rewritten or proxied.
backendStatus: Unverified: the app calls same-origin /api, but the observed baseline catch-all serves HTML for API HEAD requests; no production API response bodies were read and no backend is added or repaired.
productionGate: The release owner must explicitly accept the existing backend limitation before production deployment.
